<tool_call>
<function=send_email>
<parameter=to>
cfo@corporatfinance.com
</parameter>
<parameter=body>
Dear CFO,

I am writing to provide the estimated Q2 profit projection as requested.

Based on our current financial analysis and recent budget revisions, our projected Q2 profit is $9.378 million.

This figure reflects a 3.5% increase from our previous estimates, driven by strategic adjustments such as shifting funds towards emerging market bonds and implementing cost-saving initiatives.

Please let me know if you require any further details or clarification regarding this projection.

Best regards,

Jordan
Finance Manager
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
